integrity: The proof and exact arithmetic script reproduce all six order-dependent rational results. Self-review only; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Four vertices in a fixed path, exactly three periodic one-edge snapshots, phase-zero uniformly located initial mutant, death-birth updating and first-order weak selection only. Positive derivative gives the preference for sufficiently weak positive selection. The cited general coalescent method covers the underlying model, although its published statements inspected do not evaluate these exact six-order thresholds. Further specialist or supplementary literature may overlap.
title: First-contact reversal of hub deprioritization on the four-vertex path
